python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
content = root / 'content'
content.mkdir()
(content / 'post.md').write_text(
    'written: 2024-02-03T04:05:06Z\ntype: short\n\nold',
    encoding='utf-8',
)
(content / 'patches').mkdir()
(content / 'patches' / 'multi.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'id': 'multi', 'post': 'post', 'at': '2024-02-04T05:06:07Z',
    'why': '여러 문단', 'op': 'replace', 'anchor': 'old',
    'text': '첫 문단\n\n둘째 문단',
}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path.cwd() / 'build.py')], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f'exit={result.returncode}')
print((root / 'docs' / 'p' / 'post.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
if result.returncode != 0:
    print(result.stderr)
PY
